research_scope: Additional source-free contextual alias confirmations from mathematically reviewed expression/object-type differences; retain source conditions and separate meanings.

aliases.reason: Rank of a linear transformation uses dim_K(im T) for a finite-dimensional image, a direct instance of vector-space dimension as basis cardinality. Finite dimensionality is a separate hypothesis in the rank statement and is not removed.

The integrality-of-element and integral-ring-map formulations both require a monic polynomial whose coefficients originate in R and whose evaluation in S vanishes. Saying 'coefficients in the image of R' is equivalent to evaluating a monic R[T]-polynomial under R→S; injectivity of R→S is not assumed.

The prime-ideal and Noetherian-module sources both refer to an associative commutative coefficient ring with identity. R versus A are bound variable renamings; module Noetherianity and primality impose separate restrictions not part of the ring axioms.

A free module over a localized unital coefficient ring R_{f_i} is the same free-module construction over a particular base ring as the general free R-module prerequisite. Both allow arbitrary basis rank; requiring local freeness on an open cover is a distinct source-level constraint.
